csv_scope_of_work: The intent of this solicitation is to obtain Statements of Qualifications (SOQs) from qualified professional architectural rms to establish a pre-qualified pool of architects. The County intends to select one or more rms to provide on-call, task-order-based architectural, design, and consulting services for various projects that may arise over a three(3)year period

title: On-Call Architectural Services
short_description: Prequalification pool for on-call architectural and related consulting services in Comal County.
project_scope: Establishment of a pre-qualified pool of one or more professional architectural firms to provide on-call, task-order-based architectural, design, and consulting services for various county projects over a three-year period. No specific building, structure type, size, gross floor area, or technical characteristics are defined in the notice.
services: Architecture services, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, and traffic design engineering under an on-call task-order arrangement for 36 months.
relevance_explanation:
- Framework-style prequalification pool without a defined project or technical scope.
- Primarily architectural on-call services for various unspecified county projects.
- No identifiable bridge, long-span roof, special structure, stadium, or complex building opportunity.
- Includes disciplines of potential interest, but no concrete structural design package is described.
- Per sbp criteria, framework agreements without technical specification are generally not relevant.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated. The notice only establishes a three-year pre-qualified pool for future task orders, with no defined projects, sizes, or quantities. Therefore no realistic project-specific construction cost estimate is possible from the available information.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated. As this is only a prequalification pool for future on-call task orders without defined scope or project volume, no realistic sbp fee estimate is possible.
references_qualifications: Statements of Qualifications from qualified professional architectural firms are requested to establish a pre-qualified pool. No specific minimum reference counts, project types, or qualification thresholds are stated in the provided notice excerpt.
award_criteria: Not stated in the provided notice excerpt.
